label: Power premises of the route with Pruss's own premise: transfer, two-way giving, Pruss's direction
summary: #1887 slice 2 (warrant of the power premises of the route with Pruss's own premise, 42da6b2d); note docs/notes/pruss-power-premises.md. Analyst formulations; read 2026-11-23 for navigation: ST I q.104 a.3 co., ad 1, ad 3 (newadvent.org/summa/1104.htm); Met. Theta 2 1046b and Theta 5 1048a, Ross (classics.mit.edu); Pruss, 'The Actual and the Possible', sections 'An Aristotelian alternative' and 'A combined account'. One-way and two-way giving are typed extensionally on the frame's GivesAt (DEFs 62dfa893, 7bc1d667, bd4c434d, e006ddeb). Q1: P1-prime needs the collective reading (varying-holder distributive grounding holds with no necessary being, MutualAnnihilators; the one-holder reading suffices without P4-prime, law 8: C1's lesson of 197f0097). The transfer to POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each member is not valid as typed (CollectiveWithoutDistributive: replacement, backed by 'non-existence has no direct cause'); its conclusion eb41bc9a has a second support from the creator reading 9f7b1778, factive giving 3ef41442 and the withheld-giving bridge d1593e5c (56024b0c, 84cc194c); either support gives PGP's verdict at C2's foundational being c5da5e62 (2cc7e260 to b19ffd92), relocating, not corroborating, the C2 crux. Q2: with P2-delta no fixed (one-way) giver holds P1-prime's power (laws 1-2); the holder is a necessary concrete varying giver (4ce57995 to 256a5e0a, projected to b90ee2de by b1f6a376); under the creator reading the joint absence is withholding and the holder a two-way giver (law 6), the privative side of a two-way power; collapse: a necessary fixed giver's effects are necessary, so a necessary non-rational source of all actual contingents removes P5, not P4-prime (laws 3-4). Q3: inert necessary being fails P1-prime; necessitarian source fails P5; positive-outcome-only powers fail P1-prime but ground Pruss's direction (6eb4d324, needing only symmetric access of S5, projected by 95078e7b), which avoids a power for a negative state but not the abstention fact (law 7). Provisional judgment: moderate support that P1-prime's power, if real, is the privative side of a two-way power of a necessary being; not supported: the bare transfer, choice rather than chance, independent corroboration of PGP.
blocker: No premise is established. Open: the Theta 5 bridge from two-way giving to will (HAS_WILL_1, STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL 66aecdd7), blocked by the chance rival (propensity accounts; Pruss's own 'perhaps non-deterministic'); identification of the holder with GOD_4; the creator reading's warrant independent of the route; Pruss's aggregate holder; tensed withholding; intensional (single-potency) two-way powers; compatibility of varying extrinsic giving with #555's one-act simplicity reading; truth countermodel does not handle CausalityFrame parameters.
